Pidvolochysk Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Ternopil Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. This record shows a tension worth noting: it is categorized as 'fenced and protected,' yet the source's demolished field marks it as 'yes.' Pidvolochysk was the birthplace of Israel Eldad (Scheib) (1910–1995), a member of the Lehi central committee and an influential Israeli Revisionist Zionist philosopher. The Jewish population reached an extraordinary 73 percent of the town by 1900. In September 1942, the town's Jews were deported to Zbarazh, documented elsewhere in this collection; a labor camp's liquidation on June 29, 1943, saw 500 prisoners executed. Jews still resided in Pidvolochysk as recently as 2003. This cemetery is marked on a map in the 1988 Yizkor Pidvolochys'k Memorial Book.
